name: Orquesta Public API
description:
The Orquesta Public API exposes read access to your organization's prompts, execution logs,
projects, agents, and users, plus an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions proxy ("Batuta LLM")
that routes across multiple upstream models with smart per-prompt classification.

All endpoints under `/api/v1/*` are stable, versioned, and safe to integrate against. Internal
dashboard endpoints (`/api/projects/[id]/batuta/*`, `/api/agent/*`, `/api/auth/*`, etc.) are
NOT part of this contract and may change without notice.

## Authentication

Pass an API key on every request via either header:

  - `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
  - `X-API-Key: <token>`

Three token prefixes are accepted; each carries different scope semantics:

  | Prefix   | Type              | Scope             | Scopes granted                                          |
  |----------|-------------------|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
  | `oak_`   | Org API key       | Organization, or a chosen subset of its projects | DB-configured (any of `prompts:read`, `prompts:write`, `logs:read`, ...) |
  | `oclt_`  | CLI token         | Organization      | All four read scopes (synthesized), plus prompt submit    |
  | `oat_`   | Agent token       | Project (single)  | All four read scopes; queries restricted to its project  |

An `oclt_` inherits its creator's access: an org owner or admin reaches every project,
anyone else only the projects they are a member of. Projects outside that set are
reported as not found.

An `oak_` is org-wide unless it was restricted to specific projects when it was created
(or edited afterwards). A restricted key sees only those projects in every listing, and
a request naming any other project is reported as not found — the same answer as a
project that does not exist, so a key cannot enumerate the organization.

Generate keys from the dashboard: https://getorquesta.com/dashboard/settings

## Errors

Non-Batuta endpoints return `{ "error": "human-readable message" }` with status codes
401 (missing/invalid key), 403 (scope/project mismatch), 404 (not found), 500 (internal).

Batuta proxy endpoints (`/chat/completions`, `/models`) return OpenAI-compatible errors:
`{ "error": { "message": "...", "type": "auth_error" | "billing_error" | "routing_error" | "proxy_error" } }`.
